rawFindings.title: Incorrect check for Windows absolute path in utils.isAbsolute()
rawFindings.explanation: The original line accepted both backslash and forward slash as valid path separators for a Windows absolute path (e.g., c:/ or c:\). The changed line restricts this check to only backslash ('\\'), which breaks acceptance of valid Windows absolute paths using forward slashes (like 'c:/path').
rawFindings.suggestion:
Restore handling to accept both backslash and forward slash as path separators for Windows absolute paths by reverting to the original line:
if (':' === path[1] && ('\\' === path[2] || '/' === path[2])) return true;

rawFindings.title: Incorrect Windows absolute path check for paths with forward slashes
rawFindings.explanation: The original code allowed paths like 'c:/' to be considered absolute on Windows by checking if path[2] was either '\' or '/'. The updated code restricts this to only '\', making paths like 'c:/' no longer recognized as absolute, which is incorrect because on Windows, both 'c:\' and 'c:/' are valid absolute paths for drive letters.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for both '\' and '/' characters at path[2] in the condition to correctly identify Windows absolute paths with either backslash or forward slash.
